title: OrchestrationCarrierQuotedPayload
description: Payload of `orchestration.carrier.quoted` version 1. A carrier quoted a delivery the chain asked it for: its price, ETA and reliability against the Location's ceiling, and whether the delivery went to it. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know; new optional fields are an additive change.

partner_id.description: The store's Partner; the envelope's `partner_id` too.

price.description: What it asks, in minor units.

ceiling.description: The Location's ceiling then, in minor units.

eta_minutes.description: Minutes to the door, as it says.

reliability_percent.description: Its deliveries of the last 30 days delivered by their promise.

keeps_promise.description: Whether its ETA keeps the order's promise.

taken.description: Whether the delivery went to it.

refused.description: Why not, such as over the ceiling.
